title: Rigour: checkable, honest, integrity-safe
summary: Get answers you can check, and use AI in ways your university will accept.

lessons.title: Make answers checkable
lessons.body: Ask for sources you can verify, for the model to flag uncertainty, and for step-by-step working. Then check them. Models can invent references.

lessons.title: Academic integrity
lessons.body: Use AI to learn and to give feedback on your own work, not to submit its writing as yours. Read your institution's policy and declare use where required.

exercises.title: Ask for verifiable help
exercises.scenario: You need background on a topic and must cite real sources.
exercises.task: Write a prompt that asks for checkable claims and honest uncertainty.

checks.label: Asks to flag uncertainty
checks.hint: Ask it to say when it is unsure.

checks.label: Warns against invention
checks.hint: Tell it not to invent references.

exercises.model_answer_tip: 'Give me background on X. Cite real sources I can look up, say if you are unsure, and do not invent any references.'

exercises.title: Feedback, not ghost-writing
exercises.scenario: You wrote an essay draft and want help improving it without the AI writing it.
exercises.task: Ask for feedback on YOUR draft, not a rewrite.

checks.label: Refuses a rewrite
checks.hint: Say it must not rewrite or write for you.

checks.label: Refers to your own draft
checks.hint: Say it is your own work.

exercises.model_answer_tip: 'Here is my own draft. Give feedback against the marking criteria below. Do not rewrite any sentences; point to weaknesses and suggest what to improve.'

exercises.title: Declare your AI use
exercises.scenario: Your module requires an AI-use declaration.
exercises.task: Ask for help drafting an honest declaration of how you used AI.

checks.label: Asks to list what the AI did
checks.hint: Say you will list what the AI did.

checks.label: Keeps it truthful
checks.hint: Ask it to stay accurate to what you actually did.

exercises.model_answer_tip: 'Help me write a short, honest AI-use declaration. I used it only to explain concepts and check grammar. List exactly that and nothing more.'
